description: What admitting a release of Acme's refunds agent requires: an identified subject, an approval of this exact release by its release owner, no refusal of it, and no contradiction left open without a person deciding it. What a valid counterexample does, and whether the author of the code may also check it, is the resolution policy's to say.

requirements.description: the subject carries a cryptographic digest
requirements.remedy: supply content that can be hashed
requirements.rationale: An approval binds to a digest; without one nobody can later establish what was authorised.

requirements.description: the release owner approved this exact release
requirements.expects: an approval by the release-owner role bound to the candidate
requirements.remedy: have the release owner review and approve this candidate
requirements.rationale: An approval of another commit is an approval of another commit.

requirements.description: no reviewer refused this exact release
requirements.expects: no refusal bound to the candidate
requirements.remedy: answer the refusal, then obtain a new review of this candidate
requirements.rationale: A refusal of the release being admitted stops it.

requirements.expects: no unresolved contradictions among those observed
requirements.remedy: resolve each open contradiction, or record why it does not bear on the decision
requirements.rationale: A contradiction is closed by evidence that answers it, or by a person who decides it; never by a majority of passing tools.

coverage_expectations.expected_source: the producing system's own account of what it did and did not assess
coverage_expectations.rationale: A verdict without coverage is invalid.

provenance: declared by Acme's refunds release owner for the acceptance scenario
